com.vector.cfg.gen.core.testinfrastructure.published

Interface IGeneratorTestingApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @NotThreadSafe
public interface IGeneratorTestingApi
    IGeneratorTestingApi is the entry point to the generator testing APIs and provide functionality for white box tests for generators.
    The IGeneratorTestingApi provides methods to test code with white box tests which require a real IGeneratorPackage or an IGeneratorResultSink etc. of the generator under test. You can use the IGeneratorTestingApi with the call: ScriptApi.scriptCode.genTesting

    All method parameters and return values must be non-null unless documented otherwise.

      • createGenerator

        @PublishedMethod
 @Nonnull
<T extends com.vector.cfg.gen.core.moduleinterface.IGeneratorPackage> IGeneratorTestingAccess<T> createGenerator(@Nonnull
                                                                                                                                              java.lang.Class<T> generatorPackageClass)
        The createGenerator(Class) method creates an IGeneratorTestingAccess for the passed class of the IGeneratorPackage under test. The method will use the currently active project for the generator. This will always create a new generator instance.

        You can specify the used project with the method createDeployablePackage(IProjectContext, Class).

        Parameters:
        generatorPackageClass - the generator to instantiate
        Returns:
        the IGeneratorTestingAccess of the generator package
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalStateException - if there is no active IAutomationContext.IProject (i.e. if #isProjectActive() returns false)
